text: better-dsh 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的界面增强插件，通过右侧边栏标签和通用设置面板接入。它可将工作区目录路径打开为可浏览的文件夹页，集中查看需要处理、正在运行和已排期的会话任务，并提供字体字号调整和多套明暗主题。适合希望在浏览器中更方便管理工作区文件、任务状态和外观的 DSH 用户。代码没有声明额外 API 密钥或外部服务要求。

better-dsh adds workspace folder browsing and a Mission Control sidebar for pending, running, and scheduled work to the DSH web client. General settings also provide font and theme controls. It is suited to users who want a more customizable workspace interface.
想在 DSH 右侧边栏里直接浏览工作区文件夹。
DSH 有没有一个地方能看到待处理和正在运行的任务？
I want to change the fonts and colors in the DSH web interface.
better-dsh 的功能「工作区文件夹浏览」：在右侧边栏打开目录列表，可进入子目录、返回上一级或刷新，并可点文件回到常规预览。点击会话文件地址中的目录时会导向文件夹页。
better-dsh 的功能「任务中心」：打开右侧边栏任务中心，汇总需要处理的事项、运行中的会话与后台任务，以及已排期任务；点击条目可跳转到对应会话。

lizyoko-better-dsh README · better-dsh：English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

Built against [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh) `0.2.1-rc.3`.

lizyoko-better-dsh README · Directory links open properly：Clicking a directory path in chat (or `present`-ing a directory) used to show only "This path is not a regular file and has no content to display" in the right sidebar, with no buttons in the top-right corner. The preview header only renders after `stat` returns file info, and directories never get that far.

With this plugin:

lizyoko-better-dsh README · Directory links open properly：- Clicking a directory opens a folder view: a file list (folders first) with file sizes, plus up-one-level and refresh. Clicking a file still opens it in the normal preview.
- Opening files works the same as before. If the probe fails, times out, or the Remote isn't available, it falls back to the original behavior. Details in [docs/folder-browser.md](docs/folder-browser.md).
- The sidebar's `+` menu gets a "Browse folders" card for starting from the workspace root.

lizyoko-better-dsh README · Mission Control：Sessions, background jobs, approvals and scheduled tasks were spread across the sidebar, the session header, the Automation page and the right Sidebar. Mission Control pulls them into one right-Sidebar tab:

lizyoko-better-dsh README · Mission Control：- **Needs you**: approvals, plan reviews, questions and finished-but-unseen sessions, ordered by urgency.
- **Running**: active sessions and background jobs, with job counts and the last activity time.
- **Scheduled**: active scheduled tasks, ordered by the next run.
- Click any row to open its session; the three counters at the top are running / waiting / scheduled.

lizyoko-better-dsh README · Mission Control：It reads the existing Session, status, jobs and schedule client surfaces and degrades to empty lists when a service is absent, so the folder tab is unaffected. It is read-only for now: refresh and navigation work; stopping jobs, approving and running a schedule on demand are not wired yet.

lizyoko-better-dsh README · Fonts & sizes：Some 0.2 builds do not render the built-in "More font settings" row. This plugin adds a General-settings panel:

- Interface, code and terminal font families, plus their sizes (10–22, 10–16, 10–20 px).
- Leave an input empty for the default; separate fallbacks with commas.
- Reset clears the three families and restores 14 / 11 / 13 px.
- Writes through DSH's own `ui-theme` settings, so it persists and applies immediately.

lizyoko-better-dsh README · Theme Studio：Settings → General now has an Obsidian-style theme gallery:

- Obsidian, Nord, Catppuccin, Rosé Pine, Tokyo Night and Solarized, each with light and dark variants.
- The theme is an alias-token layer applied through `ctx.theme.overrideTokens`; DSH's own light/dark/system preference stays authoritative and the palette follows the OS scheme.
- A "DSH default" card removes the layer. The selected custom theme is remembered in this browser.

lizyoko-better-dsh README · Install：Install from the **Plugins** page with:

```
git+https://github.com/lizyoko9/lizyoko-better-dsh
```

Or point the installer at a local clone. No build step: `client.js` is the final artifact.

lizyoko-better-dsh README · Compatibility：Verified on DSH `0.2.1-rc.3` (first developed against `0.2.1-rc.2`). If a future release changes the tab-type registry, the Remote namespaces or the `settings.general.item` slot, the affected feature may stop loading; the Console logs are prefixed with `better-dsh:`.

The plugin only touches the Web client UI: it registers no tools, writes no session events and does not change model input.

基于 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（dsh）`0.2.1-rc.3` 开发。

lizyoko-better-dsh README · 目录链接能直接打开了：原来在聊天里点一个目录路径（或者 `present` 一个目录），右边栏只会显示一句「该路径不是普通文件，没有可显示的内容」，右上角也没有任何按钮——预览头部要等 `stat` 拿到文件信息才渲染，目录走不到那一步。

装了这个插件之后：

- 点目录会打开一个文件夹页，能看到文件列表（文件夹排前面）和文件大小，可以返回上一级、刷新，点文件还是用原来的预览打开。
- 点文件的行为没变。探测失败、超时或者拿不到 Remote 的时候，都按原来的逻辑走，细节写在 [docs/folder-browser.md](docs/folder-browser.md)。
- 右边栏「+」里加了一张「浏览文件夹」卡片，可以从工作区根目录开始翻。
section: 目录链接能直接打开了

text:
lizyoko-better-dsh README · 任务中心：会话在左栏、后台任务在会话头、定时任务在「自动化任务」页、审批在弹窗里。任务中心把这些收进右侧边栏的一个 tab：

- **需要你**：审批、计划确认、提问、已完成未查看的会话，按紧急度排序。
- **正在运行**：正在跑的会话和后台任务，带任务数和最近活动时间。
- **已排期**：活跃定时任务，按下次触发时间排序。
- 点任意一行跳到对应会话；顶部三个数字是运行中 / 待处理 / 已排期。

读取 Session、status、jobs、schedule 的既有客户端面，服务缺失时降级为空列表，不影响文件夹页。当前是只读 MVP：刷新和跳转已通，停任务、批准、立即执行排期还没接。

lizyoko-better-dsh README · 字体与字号：这个构建的设置页里没有「更多字体设置」，所以插件在设置 → 通用里加了一块面板：

- 界面、代码、终端三种字体，以及各自字号（10–22、10–16、10–20 px）。
- 输入框留空恢复默认字体；多个字体用逗号分隔。
- 「恢复默认」清空三个字体并恢复 14 / 11 / 13 px。
- 写入 DSH 自己的 `ui-theme` 设置，持久化并即时生效。

lizyoko-better-dsh README · 主题工作室：设置 → 通用新增类似 Obsidian 的主题画廊：

- 内置 Obsidian、Nord、Catppuccin、Rosé Pine、Tokyo Night、Solarized，每套都有亮色和暗色变体。
- 主题通过 `ctx.theme.overrideTokens` 作为别名 token 层应用；DSH 自带的亮色/暗色/系统仍然生效，配色会跟随系统切换。
- 「DSH 默认」卡片会移除覆盖层；自定义主题只记录在当前浏览器。

lizyoko-better-dsh README · 安装：在 **Plugins** 页面填入：

```
git+https://github.com/lizyoko9/lizyoko-better-dsh
```

或者选择本地克隆目录安装。没有构建步骤，`client.js` 就是最终产物。

lizyoko-better-dsh README · 兼容性：在 DSH `0.2.1-rc.3` 上验证（首次开发针对 `0.2.1-rc.2`）。如果后续版本改了 tab 类型注册表、Remote 命名空间或 `settings.general.item` 槽位，对应功能可能加载失败；Console 里的日志带 `better-dsh:` 前缀。

插件只改 Web 端 UI：不注册工具、不写会话事件、不改变模型输入。
